# Priscilla Grant

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- **Titles:** dream girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is described as a pale, spiritual-looking maiden.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Priscilla is thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious in her studies. Despite her spiritual appearance, she is filled to the brim with mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Traits

- thoughtful  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- imaginative  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- ambitious  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- mischievous  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>
- fun-loving  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## History

While teaching school, Mr. Phillips wrote verses addressed "To Priscilla." Later, Priscilla attended the Queen's Academy, where she became part of an intimate circle of friends that included Anne Shirley and Stella Maynard.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_
